mcqs.q: How did Marx define social class?
options: The symmetrical family means families with the same number of boys and girls.
Marx defined class by occupational status like the Registrar General.
By relationship to the means of production: the bourgeoisie own productive resources; the proletariat sell their labour. Class is a structural relationship, not just income level.
Marx defined class by how much money people earn.

mcqs.q: What is Young and Willmott's symmetrical family thesis?
options: Marx defined class by occupational status like the Registrar General.
The symmetrical family means families with the same number of boys and girls.
That modern families have moved toward more shared, joint roles between partners — domestic and economic responsibilities increasingly shared, in contrast to segregated traditional roles.
The symmetrical family means men and women now do exactly equal amounts of housework.
